notes.title: DEV PATCHNOTE
notes.content:
Clint City,
Here is an update that will draw on the potential of the “World” redesign.
You will notice that, upon entering the game, things are clearer and friendlier, with a simple access to the game's main sections.
The PLAY button moves to the center and will take you to the GAME MODES page. The latter has also been entirely redesigned and will tell you, at a glance, what the different modes are and which Daily Boxes have yet to be completed...

Indeed, the big change is that EACH game mode (except for Dojo, Arcade and Event) now has its own Daily Box.
For simplicity, we have removed the Daily Boxes devoted to EFC zones and put in the prizes right into the rankings and all the Daily Boxes!
In order to collect the Daily Box rewards, all you will need to do is fight 5 battles in each room.
They will be available every day but the difference is that, from now on, there will be 6 of them!

Another very important new feature is your Missions tracker!
From now on, you will be able to follow the Missions more closely since, as each of your Missions progresses, you will see it in real time.
On the results page, after each battle, the “Missions” button will show you your latest Missions, whether in progress or completed, and you will be able to collect your rewards at any time. The summary of your rewards will always be available in your emails, in the “Notifications” section. That way, you won't miss a thing.

Another last bit of news, while we're on the subject of notifications, is that they will show up to let you know that something is happening at a given place in the game!


Happy gaming!

notes.title: Check out the Advent Calendar, tenderfoot!
notes.content:
Every day of December is a true delight in Clint City: the city is in full party mode and even more chaotic than usual! Just imagine that every day you will be able to retrieve gifts from the Christmas tree  and from the daily Flash missions found on the website. In addition, there is a chance of stumbling on a random Gold Collector in the Bronze and Silver chests!

As we were saying, the Christmas period is a perfect mess, no less on account of Kougloff, whom you will discover in the Comic story “Coal Christmas”!
So don't forget to drop by every day to collect your gifts and try your luck with the Collector chests... not forgetting the free Christmas card... on the 25th... if you complete EVERY daily mission successfully!

To sum it up:
- Advent Calendar on the website
- daily missions with the Christmas card as the ultimate reward
- jumbled up Collector chests...

This all starts today!

notes.title: Arcade Update
notes.content:
Hello UR players, 
As announced a month ago, here are the changes we made in the Arcade mode:

- Unlocking adventures for all seasons will now cost 20 credits each and a Continue will amount to 2 credits everywhere.
If you have already unlocked an adventure, you will not have to pay to finish it.

- Exceptionally, the first 2 adventures in Season 1 will remain free of charge. 
Their purpose was to introduce new players to the mode and we think that they should remain as they are.

- The bonus seasons will be deactivated next week.
We created the bonus seasons as an alternative method to winning Rebirth and Legendary cards. However, this was before we introduced the weekly LD missions. Now that the Rebirth cards no longer exist, we believe that these seasons serve no further purpose.
You have one week in which to complete the bonus seasons and gain all the rewards you are missing before their deletion!

- Last but not least: get ready for Season 4, coming soon… ; )
